For more information and to order stereo imagery products, please refer to the GEO Stereo Imagery Order Form.

  • Time of Capture: April 2nd, 2021 - June 1st, 2021 
  • Number of Frames: 59,731 frames 
  • Resolution: 16 centimetre 
  • Bit-depth: 16-bit 
  • Number of bands: Four band (RGBN) 
  • Format: TIFF (ISAT AT model setup) 
  • Camera(s): Vexcel UltraCam X and Vexcel UltraCam Eagle frame-based 

For more information on the Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (COOP) 2021 please see the main COOP 2021 GeoHub record. 

 
Available Products: 
Stereo Frames 
  • Central Ontario Orthophotography Project (COOP) 2021 - Stereo Frames and associated AT Models 

Contact Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources - Geospatial Ontario, imagery@ontario.ca
